$comment: Short cards for secondary projects. Facts verified against the repos on 2026-11-01. Private repos have no link.

items.title: Interview Gym
items.what: A trainer I built for my own interview preparation: algorithm patterns with Python running in the browser, behavioral and system-design practice, a 14-day plan.
items.detail: Every reference solution is executed against its tests at build time (at least 4 tests per exercise) — content cannot ship broken.
items.numbers: 12 patterns · 377 problems · 57 behavioral questions · 35 system-design cases

items.title: babyloop
items.what: A mobile app for a family's baby-sleep routine, used at home first: one-tap events and the next sleep time.
items.detail: Sleep calculations exist twice — a Python core and an offline TypeScript port — and the same JSON cases run in pytest and Jest to prove they agree. Colour contrast is computed by a test for every token pair in every theme.
items.numbers: Design system v1 in 4 parts · light, dark and a dedicated night theme

items.title: sexy-hooks
items.what: A VS Code extension with snippets for React hooks.
items.detail: 13 snippets with keyboard shortcuts; MIT licensed.
